description:
The National Malaria Control Programme is planning a mass distribution of Insecticide Treated Nets (ITNs) based on a policy of Universal Coverage (1 net per 1.8 persons). You need to configure DHIS2 to calculate this automatically.

1. Create a Constant named 'ITN Universal Coverage Ratio' with a value of 1.8.
2. Create an Indicator named 'Projected ITN Needs (Estimated)' that divides the total 'Population' data element by this constant.
3. Create a Pivot Table visualization named 'ITN Needs Projection by District' showing this new indicator for all districts in Sierra Leone for the year 2022.

Use the Maintenance app for configuration and Data Visualizer for the report. Login credentials: admin / district.
